title: Economy: market, class change and resets
summary: What the market charges and pays, and what a class change, a stat reset and a skill tree reset cost.

blocks.text: The buying price of an item is ⌊ v a l u e a t r a n k E × r a n k f a c t o r × 4 ⌋ \lfloor \mathrm{value\ at\ rank\ E} \times \mathrm{rank\ factor} \times 4 \rfloor ⌊ value at rank E × rank factor × 4 ⌋ . You sell back at 80% of the price you paid (or of the value it dropped with), plus 80% of the shards you invested in the forge.

blocks.text: The first change of a profile is free. After that: max ⁡ ( 1000 , 100 × l e v e l , s t a t r e s e t c o s t ) \max(1000,\ 100 \times \mathrm{level},\ \mathrm{stat\ reset\ cost}) max ( 1000 , 100 × level , stat reset cost ) shards, with 60 s between two changes. Your level is kept by steps of 50 (449 → 400; under 50: 10; under 10: 1), or you can reset everything. Stat points and skill trees are given back.
